MailSink.//MailDirectory: Where .eml files go, unless Blob:ServiceUri sends them to blob storage instead.
MailSink.//Credentials: One client: set Username and Password, and its mail goes to the root of MailDirectory. Several: leave both empty and fill in Accounts instead.
MailSink.//Accounts: Keyed by a name for the account. Folder defaults to that key; an empty Folder writes to the root. Passwords belong in appsettings.local.json or Key Vault, never here.

Retention.//: MaxAge 0 keeps captured mail forever; 7.00:00:00 deletes .eml files older than a week.

Blob.//: Set ServiceUri to send mail to Azure Blob Storage instead of the filesystem, read and written with a managed identity: https://<account>.blob.core.windows.net. No key, no SAS.
Blob.//Containers: Each account writes to a container named by its Folder, so a role assignment can grant one account's mail and nothing else. Container below takes the mail that belongs to no account.
